GetTaskListV2.taskType: Task type, currently only supports InstanceGroupReplicas.
GetTaskListV2.targetID: Task target object ID. When task type is InstanceGroupReplicas, targetID is the ID of the target node group.
GetTaskListV2.operationType: Operation type. Supported values: [ScalingUp, ScalingDown, Repair, ExistedScaleup]. ScalingUp: scale out; ScalingDown: scale in; Repair: scaling adjustment by modifying desired node count; ExistedScaleup: adding existing nodes to a node group.
GetTaskListV2.phase: Task status. Supported values: [Pending, Processing, Done, Aborted, Collecting].
GetTaskListV2.order: Sort order. Supported values: [ASC, DESC]. Default is DESC. ASC is effective only when orderBy is non-empty.
GetTaskListV2.orderBy: Sort field. Currently only supports [startTime]. Default is startTime (creation time).
GetTaskListV2.pageNo: Page number for query. Set to 0 to disable pagination.
GetTaskListV2.pageSize: Number of entries per page. Set to 0 to disable pagination.
